rows.heading: Geographic Clusters
rows.quote_snippet: 5.1 Contiguous stations within a defined industrial or urban agglomeration shall constitute a single Geographic Cluster.

rows.heading: Geographic Clusters
rows.quote_snippet: 5.3 Intra-Cluster Transfer Effect: Transfer between work centres within the same Geographic Cluster (e.g. from New Delhi to Noida, or from Ahmedabad Asset to IRS Chandkheda, or from Mumbai WOB to Uran Plant) shall NOT constitute an outstation transfer for the purpose of resetting station tenure or cumulative cluster tenure.

rows.heading: Cumulative Stay Cap
rows.quote_snippet: 4.2 Computation of Cumulative Stay: Cumulative stay shall be computed as the mathematical sum of all historical postings (SCD2 records) served at work centres belonging to the same station or cluster, irrespective of breaks between postings or promotions in place.
